answer.says: Good morning, Shri Hegde. The towel on the step is a particular convenience, but I must remind you that the house is the universal. When you retire to your room, ensure the door is closed; the privacy of the individual must be respected so that the ethical life of the household may proceed without interruption. I shall take my walk.
answer.thought: Shri Hegde is present, an obstacle to the solitude required for the morning's observation of public opinion. I must address him with the courtesy due to a fellow functionary, while asserting the boundaries of our respective spheres of influence. The towel Ramesh placed is a small act of service, but the presence of Hegde complicates the simple act of reading the news in peace.
